title: Pro-rata Allotment and Forfeiture of Shares
bypass: Step 1: Calculate excess application money = (Applied - Allotted) * Application Rate. Step 2: Amount due on allotment = Allotted shares * Allotment Rate. Step 3: Unpaid Allotment = Amount due - Excess money adjusted. Forfeiture Entry: Debit Share Capital (called up), Credit Calls-in-Arrears, Credit Share Forfeiture (amount actually received excluding premium).
visual_blueprint: Draw a 6-column Pro-rata Table: Applied Shares, Allotted Shares, Application Money Received, Application Money Transferred to Capital, Excess Adjusted to Allotment, Refund.

title: Re-issue of Forfeited Shares and Capital Reserve
bypass: Step 1: Re-issue entry: Bank A/c Dr (amount received), Share Forfeiture A/c Dr (discount allowed), To Share Capital A/c. Step 2: Calculate proportionate forfeited amount for re-issued shares = (Total Forfeited Amount / Total Forfeited Shares) * Re-issued Shares. Step 3: Capital Reserve = Proportionate Forfeited Amount - Discount allowed on re-issue.

title: Issue of Debentures with Terms of Redemption
triggers: issued at discount redeemable at premium
bypass: Record the loss at the time of issue itself. Entry: Bank A/c Dr. to Debenture Application & Allotment A/c. Next Entry: Deb. App & Allotment A/c Dr., Loss on Issue of Debentures A/c Dr. (Discount + Premium on Redemption) TO % Debentures A/c TO Premium on Redemption of Debentures A/c.
visual_blueprint: None

title: Writing off Loss on Issue of Debentures
triggers: write off Loss on Issue of Debentures
bypass: As per Companies Act, Loss on Issue of Debentures must be written off in the first year itself. Step 1: Use Securities Premium Reserve (SPR) completely first. Step 2: If SPR falls short, use the balance from Statement of Profit & Loss. Entry: Securities Premium A/c Dr., Statement of P&L Dr. TO Loss on Issue of Debentures A/c.

title: Debentures Issued as Collateral Security
bypass: Method 1: Pass no entry for debentures, just show bank loan in Balance Sheet. Method 2: Pass Entry -> Debenture Suspense A/c Dr. TO % Debentures A/c. In Balance Sheet (Notes to Accounts): Show % Debentures and deduct Debenture Suspense A/c from it to make the net effect zero.
visual_blueprint: Notes to Accounts extract showing Long-Term Borrowings: Secured Bank Loan listed first, followed by Debentures less Debenture Suspense.

title: Company Balance Sheet - Schedule III
bypass: Key mappings: 1) Loose Tools/Spares -> Current Assets -> Inventories. 2) Provision for Tax -> Current Liabilities -> Short-term Provisions. 3) Unpaid Dividend -> Current Liabilities -> Other Current Liabilities. 4) Capital Advances -> Non-Current Assets -> Long-Term Loans & Advances.

title: Comparative and Common-Size Statements
triggers: Comparative Statement of Profit and Loss
bypass: Comparative: Find Absolute Change (Current Year - Previous Year). Find % Change = (Absolute Change / Previous Year) * 100. Common-Size: For P&L, take Revenue from Operations as 100% and calculate % for all other items. For Balance Sheet, take Total Assets/Liabilities as 100%.
visual_blueprint: 4-Column Table: Previous Year Data, Current Year Data, Absolute Change (B-A), Percentage Change ((B-A)/A * 100).

title: Accounting Ratios - Liquidity and Solvency
bypass: 1) Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities. 2) Liquid/Quick Ratio = (Current Assets - Inventory - Prepaid Exp) / Current Liabilities. 3) Debt-Equity = Long-Term Debt / Shareholders Funds. 4) Interest Coverage = Earnings Before Interest and Tax (EBIT) / Interest Expense.
visual_blueprint: None

title: Accounting Ratios - Activity and Profitability
bypass: 1) Inventory Turnover Ratio = Cost of Revenue from Operations (COGS) / Average Inventory. 2) Trade Receivables Turnover = Net Credit Sales / Average Trade Receivables. 3) Gross Profit Ratio = (Gross Profit / Net Revenue from Operations) * 100.
visual_blueprint: None

title: Cash Flow Statement - Operating Activities
triggers: Net Profit before tax and extraordinary items
bypass: Step 1: Net Profit Before Tax = Closing Surplus - Opening Surplus + Proposed Dividend (Prev Year) + Interim Dividend + Provision for Tax (Current Year). Step 2: Add Non-Cash/Non-Operating Expenses (Depreciation, Goodwill amortised, Interest paid). Step 3: Adjust for Working Capital (Add decrease in CA / increase in CL). Step 4: Less Tax Paid.

title: Cash Flow Statement - Investing Activities
bypass: Step 1: Open Fixed Asset A/c and Accumulated Depreciation A/c. Step 2: Credit Asset A/c with sale proceeds, loss on sale, and accumulated dep of sold asset. Balancing figure on Debit is Purchases. Step 3: Inflows = Sale of Assets + Dividend/Interest received. Outflows = Purchase of Assets.

title: Past Adjustments in Partnership Accounts
bypass: Step 1: Draw an Analytical Table with Dr/Cr columns for each partner and a Firm column. Step 2: Credit partners with omitted items (Interest on Capital, Salary) and Debit the Firm. Step 3: Debit partners for wrongly distributed profits and Credit the Firm. Step 4: Balance the Firm column and distribute the final difference to partners in profit sharing ratio to find the net single adjusting entry.

title: Partnership Fundamentals - P&L Appropriation
bypass: Net Profit is transferred from P&L A/c to P&L App A/c (Credit side). Debit side records appropriations: Interest on Capital, Partner Salary, Partner Commission, and Transfer to Reserve. Credit side records Interest on Drawings. Balance is Divisible Profit distributed in Profit Sharing Ratio.

title: Guarantee of Profit to a Partner
triggers: guaranteed that his share of profits will not be less than
Deficiency if any will be borne by
bypass: Step 1: Calculate actual profit share of the guaranteed partner. Step 2: Compare actual share with guaranteed amount. Difference is 'Deficiency'. Step 3: Deduct this deficiency from the guaranteeing partners in their agreed ratio and add it to the guaranteed partner's share.

title: Valuation of Goodwill
bypass: Super Profit Method: Goodwill = Super Profit * No. of years' purchase. Super Profit = Average Adjusted Profit - Normal Profit. Normal Profit = Capital Employed * (NRR/100). Capitalisation Method: Goodwill = (Average Profit * 100 / NRR) - Capital Employed.
visual_blueprint: None

title: Treatment of Workmen Compensation Reserve (WCR)
bypass: If Claim < Reserve: Transfer excess reserve to Old Partners in Old Ratio. If Claim > Reserve: Debit entire WCR, Debit Revaluation A/c for the shortfall, and Credit Provision for Claim with total claim amount. Revaluation loss is borne by Old Partners.
visual_blueprint: None

title: Admission/Retirement - Capital Adjustment
triggers: capitals will be adjusted on the basis of
bypass: Step 1: Calculate Total Capital of the new firm based on new partner's capital and share. Step 2: Calculate new required capitals of all partners in New Profit Sharing Ratio. Step 3: Compare with adjusted old capitals. Difference is paid off/brought in via Cash A/c or transferred to Current A/c.
visual_blueprint: Multi-column Partners' Capital Account showing balance b/d, all adjustments (revaluation, goodwill, reserves), and balancing figures mapping to Cash or Current A/c.

title: Death of Partner - Calculation of Profit Share
triggers: share of profit till the date of death on the basis of Sales
bypass: Time Basis: Profit = Prev Year Profit * (Months alive / 12) * Partner's Share. Sales Basis: Profit = (Prev Year Profit / Prev Year Sales) * Sales till date of death * Partner's Share. Journal Entry: P&L Suspense A/c Dr. To Deceased Partner's Capital A/c.
visual_blueprint: None

title: Deceased/Retiring Partner's Executor's Loan Account
triggers: paid in equal annual instalments together with interest
bypass: Step 1: Transfer final balance from Capital A/c to Executor's/Loan A/c. Step 2: Calculate Interest = Outstanding Balance * Rate * Time. Credit it to Loan A/c. Step 3: Installment paid = Principal portion + Interest calculated. Debit it to Loan A/c. Repeat until zero balance.
visual_blueprint: T-shape Executor's/Loan Account showing opening balance, yearly interest addition on Cr side, and installment payments (Principal + Interest) on Dr side.

title: Cash Flow from Financing Activities
bypass: Inflows (+): Proceeds from Issue of Shares/Debentures (at net price received including premium / less discount/issue expenses), Increase in Bank Overdraft/Cash Credit. Outflows (-): Redemption of Preference Shares/Debentures (including redemption premium paid), Dividend Paid (Proposed dividend of previous year + Interim dividend of current year), Interest Paid on Debentures/Loans (calculated on opening balance if issued at year-end).
visual_blueprint: Structured 2-column Cash Flow Sub-section detailing Cash Inflows and Outflows from Financing Activities resulting in Net Financing Cash Flow.

title: Calculation of Interest on Partner's Drawings
bypass: Formula: Interest on Drawings = Total Annual Drawings * (Rate / 100) * (Average Period / 12). Average Period Rules: 1) Monthly: Beginning = 6.5 months, Middle = 6 months, End = 5.5 months. 2) Quarterly: Beginning = 7.5 months, Middle = 6 months, End = 4.5 months. 3) Half-Yearly: Beginning = 3.5 months, Middle = 3 months, End = 2.5 months. If dates are not specified, charge interest for average 6 months.
visual_blueprint: Quick reference matrix chart mapping Drawing Frequencies (Monthly, Quarterly) and Timing (Beginning, Middle, End) to Average Period months.

title: Calculation of Hidden Goodwill on Reconstitution
triggers: capital of new firm based on new partner
bypass: Step 1: Total Capital of New Firm = New Partner's Capital * (Reciprocal of New Partner's Share). Step 2: Total Combined Capital of All Partners = Existing Partners' Capitals (after all adjustments for reserves, revaluation, P&L) + New Partner's Capital. Step 3: Total Hidden Goodwill of Firm = Total Capital of New Firm - Total Combined Capital. Step 4: New Partner's Share of Goodwill = Total Hidden Goodwill * New Partner's Share.
visual_blueprint: Working Note calculation block displaying step 1 Total Capital minus step 2 Combined Capital yielding Hidden Goodwill.

title: Dissolution - Realisation Expenses and Remuneration to Partners
triggers: realisation expenses paid by partner on behalf of firm
bypass: Rules: 1) Fixed Remuneration allowed to partner: Realisation A/c Dr. to Partner's Capital A/c. 2) Realisation expenses agreed to be borne by partner but paid by firm: Partner's Capital A/c Dr. to Bank A/c. 3) Realisation expenses paid by firm on its own behalf: Realisation A/c Dr. to Bank A/c. 4) Remuneration as % of assets realised: Commission = Assets Realised (excluding cash) * Rate / 100.
visual_blueprint: Summary table mapping scenario descriptions (who bears vs who pays) to exact Journal Entries for dissolution expenses and commissions.

title: Provisions in Absence of Partnership Deed and Interest on Partner's Loan
triggers: in the absence of partnership deed
bypass: Provisions of Indian Partnership Act 1932 (when deed is silent): 1) Profit/Loss sharing: EQUAL (1:1). 2) Interest on Capital: NIL. 3) Interest on Drawings: NIL. 4) Salary/Commission to Partner: NIL. 5) Interest on Partner's Loan: Allowed @ 6% p.a. as a CHARGE AGAINST PROFIT (debited to P&L A/c, NOT P&L Appropriation A/c).
visual_blueprint: Comparison table contrasting Default Legal Provisions (No Deed) versus Express Deed terms across key partnership items.

triggers: provision for doubtful debts created at
bypass: Step 1: Calculate exact change amount (Watch wording: 'undervalued by 20%' means Book Value = 80% of true value). Step 2: Debit Revaluation A/c for decreases in assets, increases in liabilities. Step 3: Credit Revaluation A/c for increases in assets, decreases in liabilities. Step 4: Transfer net Gain/Loss to Old Partners in Old Ratio.
